text:
# filter.withIgnored

TL;DR:
- filter.withIgnored controls whether ignored listings are still included for the current actor.

What it means:
- It adjusts inclusion of actor-ignored listings in a search result.

Agent hint:
- Use this only when the workflow explicitly needs to include ignored items instead of the default buyer-facing view.
